title: Creamy Polish Spinach Pierogi
description: A comforting, jammy pierogi dish featuring spinach and a creamy filling, perfect for a sick day.

ingredients.name: 1 package of store-bought or homemade pierogi dough
Optional: 1/4 cup of chopped fresh dill

instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pierogi according to the package instructions.
In a large skillet, melt the butter over medium heat. Add the spinach and cook until wilted.
In a medium bowl, whisk together the yogurt, mustard, salt, and pepper.
Add the cooked spinach to the bowl and stir to combine.
Add the yogurt-spinach mixture to the cooked pierogi and toss to coat.
Serve the pierogi hot, garnished with chopped fresh dill if desired.

axes.dishForm: Kiełbasa (Polish Sausage) isn't here so we go for the nearest one: Pierogi
